category_edits.rationale: Add a deterministic causal repeat-count feature within each retained input prefix: scale existing input embeddings by 1 + 0.1*log1p(min(c, 5)), where c counts strictly earlier occurrences of the same item. This adds no parameters and preserves embeddings, GRU topology, readout, loss, optimizer, sampling and routing. The generated predictor imports the updated model class, ensuring identical inference features.
